extracted.name: Smoked Cream Cheese
instruction_lines: Coat extremely lightly with olive oil
Unwrap your cream cheese and sprinkle your rub onto a plate large enough to hold the cream cheese
Roll the cream cheese making sure it is coated in the rub
Transfer the block of cheese to a disposable foil pan and using a sharp paring knife, make cross hatches by cutting into the cream cheese.
Smoke the cream cheese low and slow at 225-F for about 2 hours
Eat with ritz crackers and a sweet hot jelly
